name: gemma4_q4_k_m_basic_prompt_logits_reference
source: bartowski/google_gemma-4-E4B-it-GGUF google_gemma-4-E4B-it-Q4_K_M.gguf at revision c04cb322fd63e347db759a08b6249b867488ccf8; final-token logits reference is produced by llama.cpp examples/debug with --save-logits.
reference_status: Live opt-in llama.cpp reference harness. The repository does not commit the full 262k-logit dump; the ignored test runs llama-debug locally, parses the full final-token logits vector, and compares every Ocelotl dequantized text-path logit against those values.

llama_cpp_reference.source: ggml-org/llama.cpp examples/debug; llama-debug evaluates the prompt, then --save-logits writes the final-token logits to llamacpp-<model-stem>.txt in the selected output directory.

ocelotl_reference.notes: The Ocelotl side tokenizes with the GGUF tokenizer configured-BOS path, clears Gemma4Config.multimodal for this text-only harness, loads required dense fallback tensors plus validated native Q4_K/Q5_K/Q6_K text-projection sidecars, builds Gemma4TextModel, and compares the full final-position logits vector. The llama.cpp flags pin the scalar/non-flash F32-cache, non-repacked comparison surface used by the layer discriminators. The 2026-07-10 full comparison remains red: max absolute error 2.1698594, mean absolute error 0.38767775, RMS error 0.48177935, identical top-1, and 18/20 top-20 overlap.

regeneration: Build llama.cpp examples/debug at the pinned revision, set OCELOTL_GEMMA4_GGUF_PATH and OCELOTL_LLAMA_DEBUG_PATH, then run the ignored local parity test. If the selected artifact, prompt, tokenizer, llama.cpp revision, selected token IDs, or tolerance changes, update this fixture plus docs/validation/parity.md, docs/artifact-preparation.md, and docs/validation/test-matrix.md together.
